codecs.name: ALP
codecs.summary: Adaptive Lossless floating-Point; suitable for time series data.

codecs.name: Delta
codecs.summary: Preprocessor (should be followed by some compression codec). Stores difference between neighboring values; good for monotonically increasing or decreasing data.

codecs.name: DoubleDelta
codecs.summary: Stores difference between neighboring delta values; suitable for time series data.

codecs.name: FPC
codecs.summary: High Throughput Compression of Double-Precision Floating-Point Data.

codecs.name: GCD
codecs.summary: Preprocessor. Greatest common divisor compression; divides values by a common divisor; effective for divisible integer sequences.

codecs.name: Gorilla
codecs.summary: Calculates XOR between current and previous value; suitable for slowly changing numbers.

codecs.name: LZ4
codecs.summary: Extremely fast; good compression; balanced speed and efficiency.

codecs.name: LZ4HC
codecs.summary: LZ4 High Compression algorithm with configurable level; slower but better compression than LZ4, but decompression is still fast.

codecs.name: Multiple
codecs.summary: Apply multiple codecs consecutively defined by user.

codecs.name: NONE
codecs.summary: No compression. Can be used on columns that can not be compressed anyway.

codecs.name: Quantized
codecs.summary: Stores a compact quantized companion stream of a dense vector column for fast nearest-neighbour search; the full-precision data is stored uncompressed.

codecs.name: SZ3
codecs.summary: SZ3 is a lossy compressor for floating-point data with error bounds.

codecs.name: T64
codecs.summary: Preprocessor. Crops unused high bits; puts them into a 64x64 bit matrix; optimized for 64-bit data types.

codecs.name: ZSTD
codecs.summary: Good compression; pretty fast; best for high compression needs. Don’t use levels higher than 6.

codecs.name: ZXC
codecs.summary: Asymmetric LZ codec (zxc): slow compression, very fast decompression, ratio between LZ4 and ZSTD. Levels 1..7.

skipIndexTypes.name: bloom_filter

skipIndexTypes.name: minmax

skipIndexTypes.summary: Stores the minimum and maximum values of the index expression for each granule, allowing granules to be skipped when a query's range condition cannot match.

skipIndexTypes.name: ngrambf_v1

skipIndexTypes.summary: A Bloom filter over all n-grams of the index expression's string values, for speeding up LIKE, IN, equality and similar searches on substrings.

skipIndexTypes.name: set
skipIndexTypes.syntax: INDEX name expr TYPE set(max_rows) GRANULARITY n
skipIndexTypes.summary: Stores up to `max_rows` distinct values of the index expression per granule (0 means unlimited), allowing granules to be skipped for equality and IN conditions.

skipIndexTypes.name: sparse_grams
skipIndexTypes.syntax: INDEX name expr TYPE sparse_grams(min_ngram_length, max_ngram_length[, min_cutoff_length], size_in_bytes, num_hash_functions, seed) GRANULARITY g
skipIndexTypes.summary: A Bloom filter over the sparse n-grams of the index expression's string values, for speeding up substring searches.

skipIndexTypes.name: text
skipIndexTypes.syntax: INDEX name expr TYPE text(tokenizer = splitByNonAlpha) GRANULARITY g
skipIndexTypes.summary: A full-text (inverted) index over the tokens of a string column, for speeding up text search functions such as `hasToken`, `hasAnyTokens`, `hasAllTokens`, and `hasPhrase`.

skipIndexTypes.name: tokenbf_v1
skipIndexTypes.syntax: INDEX name expr TYPE tokenbf_v1(size_in_bytes, num_hash_functions, seed) GRANULARITY g
skipIndexTypes.summary: A Bloom filter over the tokens (words) of the index expression's string values, for speeding up searches of whole tokens.

skipIndexTypes.name: vector_similarity

skipIndexTypes.summary: An approximate nearest-neighbour index over a vector column (built using HNSW), for speeding up `ORDER BY <distance_function>(vector, reference) LIMIT n` queries.
